_about: Where-to-buy info shown on each dashboard card. Keyed by Yahoo symbol suffix ('US' = no suffix, 'CRYPTO' = -USD pairs). Edit freely. Listings are examples, not endorsements; availability depends on your country of residence.
_general: Use a cash account: no margin, no short selling, no options (these are generally not Shariah-compliant).
Where a broker offers an Islamic or Shariah account, prefer it.
Check the broker is licensed by the market's regulator and accepts residents of your country.

brokers.name: Sahm
brokers.note: US and Saudi stocks in one app, includes a Shariah filter

brokers.name: Baraka
brokers.note: GCC-focused app with a Musaffa-sourced Sharia screener

steps: Open an account with a broker that serves your country
Fund it (USD conversion applies)
Search the ticker and buy with a limit order

brokers.name: SNB Capital
brokers.note: Also the local partner behind IBKR's Saudi access

brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
brokers.note: For investors outside Saudi: add 'Saudi Arabia' in Trading Permissions

steps: Saudi residents: open an account with a CMA-licensed broker
Foreign investors: use a broker offering Tadawul access (e.g. IBKR)
Search the 4-digit code

.JK.code_hint: Search the 4-letter code (e.g. TLKM). Shares trade in lots of 100.
steps: Open an account with an IDX member broker (you receive an SID investor number)
Choose a SOTS (Sharia) account: it only allows ISSI-listed Sharia shares and no margin
Search the 4-letter code

.KL.code_hint: Search the 4-digit stock code (e.g. 5347) or the stock name.
steps: Open a CDS account plus a trading account with a Bursa participating broker
Ask for an Islamic stockbroking account where offered
Search the stock code; board lot is 100 shares

.AE.code_hint: Search the ticker as shown without .AE (e.g. EMAAR).

brokers.name: DFM: how to trade
brokers.note: Official steps and licensed broker list

steps: Get a free DFM Investor Number (NIN); non-residents can apply online
Appoint a DFM-licensed broker
Trade through the broker's app or iVestor

.QA.code_hint: Search the ticker as shown without .QA (e.g. QIBK).

brokers.name: QSE: how to open an account

steps: Get a National Investor Number (NIN) from the Qatar Central Securities Depository; a licensed broker can fast-track it with your trading account (QR 100 fee)
Open a trading account with that broker
Search the ticker

.IS.code_hint: Search the ticker as shown without .IS (e.g. BIMAS).
steps: Open an account with a CMB-licensed Turkish brokerage (foreigners usually need a Turkish tax number)
Transfer funds (TRY)
Search the ticker

CRYPTO.code_hint: Buy the coin itself (spot), e.g. BTC. POL was formerly MATIC.

brokers.name: Coinbase
brokers.note: Source of the live prices on this page

steps: Use spot buying only: avoid futures, margin, leverage and lending/earn products
Check the exchange is licensed in your country
Consider moving long-term holdings to your own wallet
